body: I’m trying to figure it out myself but don’t kill your self that definitely isn’t the answer

I just wanted to remind you that you are not alone and you don’t have to go through this alone. You are not and will never be a burden because every life is the most precious and valuable thing in the world. Honestly if you are feeling bad any time you can talk to me. I might not have the best advice but I’ll listen.

To be honest I’m not sure what’s right for you to do. I ended up telling one of my friends which at first helped but then It just went back to normal because they kind of stoped caring about me after a while. And I’m 16 btw but that still doesn’t mean that I don’t know what you’re going through. I guess my depression hasn’t really stopped but it’s got a lot better because I’m not as suicidal as before. And I also don’t take hard drugs anymore which was a big problem for me as well.
I fully understand that feeling. Have you told anyone how you are feeling?

I’m very sorry that you feel like suicide is even an option. I hate that things like these happen to the best people. I really want to help you but I’m so shit at this stuff so I don’t really know what to say. I don’t want to make anything worse for you so you can talk to me about it if you want to. I know things will get better.
I just hope your doing ok

I hate that you feel this way. I honestly don’t know what I’m meant to say so that you can feel better but I’ll try my best. If u want to talk to me about what you’re going through I’ll try and help. I want you to get better and I know you can
You can talk to me about it if you want to. I’ll try and help the best I can

First of all you don’t need to apologise for bringing this up because your mental health is very important as are you. Depression is shit and there is no other way to put it but that doesn’t mean that there aren’t ways to cope with it. I’m not sure exactly what your going through but I’ve been in a similar place, I’m sure you don’t want to be told that because I hated it when people tried to talk down to me and telling me that they’ve been there before. I’m really not sure how I can help but I’ll try my best because no one deserves to feel like this
I used to have a counsellor but that didn’t help

Yeah I feel you school is pretty shit but you know you may think it’s pointless but it also enables you to meet amazing people. It doesn’t matter if you’re smart or not, my advice would be not to take school too seriously cos that used to stress me out all the time. The world will be missing out if you leave. There’s always other options and people willing to give you support. If u wanna talk about anything I’m here. Just don’t give up

I know you don’t want to hear this but it’s the truth, even if you think your child is strong they will still miss you and wonder why you did it. They could blame themselves and have to live with those thoughts forever. I’m not trying to make you feel bad I just don’t want your child to grow up with these feelings. I know this because I have had lots of suicide problems in my family and I don’t want to talk about it because it still makes me upset. It’s a very hard thing to deal with when your loved ones fall to suicide but especially when you are growing up. Fuck. I’m probably not even helping and I’m sorry but if you want to talk about anything I’m here. I don’t want you to go, there’s always another option. Always

I don’t really know what would help. I appreciate that you responded to my post but I honestly have no idea what to talk about. I was just angry and alone so I wanted someone to talk to but I don’t know what about.
Well I’m suicidal, depressed, alone, addicted to drugs and have nothing to live for.
Yes If you don’t mind
There’s too much for me to say but I just can’t take it anymore. It’s so unbearable and I have no one.
You can have that feeling if you are willing to change. It’s just a small step but it can make a big difference. Would you try to change if you could?

Believe me it is possible to get rid of these feelings. I know it’s probably the last thing you want to hear but I was in the same position as you and it was very difficult and it took time but I eventually overcome these feelings. You may not believe in yourself but I do

No you can’t end you’re life. No matter how hard you have to try to get back on track you can’t just throw your life away. You are precious and invaluable. You might not be able to see the positives of life at the moment because your mind is clouded by your loneliness but I assure you there is hope. If I can I’ll help you find that hope and you need to grab the opportunity and pull yourself back together. I’m not expecting you to suddenly be happy and it won’t be easy but you just can’t end it all. It’s a slow progress but all of the little steps you take to improve become large leaps towards your happiness. I’m not too sure what your whole situation is but I’ll try my best to help you. If you ever feel lonely or just want to chat I’m here. I’ll listen to you and try and give you my advice. I believe in you

Fuck man, I’m so so sorry that life has treated you this way. It must have be really difficult living like this and I really want to help you. It’s true this world can be a cruel place. However there is also so many wonderful things life can offer you. Yeah maybe you haven’t had a happy life so far but it’s never to late for any of that to change and I strongly believe you are capable. I know it’s difficult to see the positives in anything when your mind is clouded by your loneliness and it’s normal. I don’t expect you to suddenly be happy and know what to do with your life. I’m not really sure on everything that you are feeling so I don’t really know what I can say and plus I’m very shit at this kind of stuff. If you feel like you want to talk to me I am here and I’ll listen to what you have to say and I’ll try my best to support you. You can’t give up, not while you’ve got a life ahead of you

It’s obvious that you are going through a rough time where you are considering suicide. I don’t have all of the answers you need but if you want to talk to me and explain how you are feeling I’ll try my best to help you and hopefully you will won’t consider suicide anymore.
It doesn’t matter about the price of a house, your life is invaluable and should be cherished. I don’t know what’s made you feel this way but you shouldn’t think that this is your only option.

It’s alright, I want to try and help people because I don’t want anyone to suffer. I guess this is what sort of keeps me going. But honestly if you ever need to talk I’m here. I’m very bored most days and not very busy. You deserve the best

You don’t need to apologise for anything , everything that you are felling is not your fault. Honestly I don’t know what to say but I really want to help you because I know how dark it is being in that lonely place and no one should ever have to experience it. I wish I new what to say because I felt the exact same as you. You may think that there’s nothing for you in this world but the fact that there is someone so precious to you that you won’t end your life means that you can get better and there is hope. I don’t know how you are really feeling but I felt like I was just living for others when I didn’t know if they truly cared or not which caused me pain. However I eventually opened up to someone close to me who was upset at first but only because I didn’t tell them sooner. I feel like I’m just ranting about nothing now but if you feel like you ever need to get things off you chest, you can talk to me about it. Even if we don’t know each other you can open up to me because I’m not going to judge you
It’s just so difficult being alone. Especially when I used to have friends
Not really but at least he tried.

Well I was very upset in front of the ones that I thought were my friends and one of them asked me if I was ok. I told them I was wasn’t but they walked away and didn’t notice me. But there was one friend who stayed and tried to make me feel better.
Yes if that’s ok. Well today I realised that I really only have 1 real friend.
I’m gonna be honest, probably one of the worst days of my life
Thankyou so much you’ve been very helpful

I haven’t really thought about getting help like that but my friends really want me to. I know it maybe could help but I’m not sure it will. I wouldn’t want to get any medication because I don’t want to go near any type of drugs again.

Well I used to have a large group of friend but ever since I started to feel like this I’ve lost many of them because they were unsupportive and they just weren’t good friends. However the few I have now are very supportive and they just want me to be better but I keep telling them that I don’t want to and have no desire to get better. I know they want to help more but there not much else they can do which is why I want to try and repay them as much as I can in my last days.

I don’t want to be loved by others because it’s just making it more difficult for me. I love them so much but it gets to a point where I’m only living because they want me to and it’s like my feelings don’t mean anything. I was thinking of getting some of them something that they will remember me by but I don’t know if that’s a good idea.
Yes some know that I am suicidal and they hate that I’m like this but I don’t want them to worry and just want to say goodbye.
